chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah narrated from al-Maythami, from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah, peace be upon him, about the best time for Zuhr. He said: One cubit after the sun’s decline. He said: I asked: Is it the same in winter and summer? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الزَّوَالِ: the sun’s decline from the zenith, marking the beginning of Zuhr time
key_terms.ذِرَاعٌ: a cubit, used here as a measure of shadow length after zawal
key_terms.وَقْتِ: time, specifically the prescribed time of an act of worship

ai.seo_question: What is the best time for salat al-Zuhr according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the best time for salat al-Zuhr is one cubit after zawal. It also clarifies that this measure applies equally in both winter and summer, indicating a consistent legal timing standard.
